listing.name: Samurai Warriors 2: Xtreme Legends — sw2xl-recomp (Gargadon)
listing.summary: The XL boot and module procedure exists. Complete XL campaign coverage is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Samurai Warriors 2: Xtreme Legends Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. USA/Europe SW2 base, matching TU 3 container and XL content/SW2XL_US.dll.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build with own SW2 base/TU 3 container and XL DLC root containing SW2XL_US.dll.

warnings: The XL boot and module procedure exists. Complete XL campaign coverage is unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
